spy_shares.label: SPY shares
spy_shares.purpose: The idea that turned the desk's own signals profitable in the 6-year backtest (backtests/ideas.md): whole shares, the stop held at Alpaca.

sndk_shares.label: SNDK shares
sndk_shares.purpose: Roy's pick (2026-10-07). Same rules as SPY shares; the stop is a quarter of SNDK's average daily range (SPY's 0.25% in SNDK's terms). See backtests/ideas-sndk.md.

spy_options.label: SPY options (learning)
spy_options.purpose: Kept so the learner keeps learning options. Lost money in the backtest (backtests/current.md); paper only.

spy_spreads.label: SPY daily put spread
spy_spreads.purpose: Roy, 2026-10-07: "make profits daily ... trade regardless of anything". Sells a $5-wide SPY put spread expiring the same day, one remaining-day move below the price (VIX-sized), every day SPY has a same-day expiry; bought back at 15:40. The worst case is capped at the width minus the credit (about $470). Backtest (backtests/spreads.md, credits priced at the VIX, likely generous): won about 95% of days; this book prices with Alpaca's real quotes.

books_note: Each book trades on its own: one position at a time, its own daily entry limit and budget, capped by the cash in the account. Shares are whole so Alpaca can hold the stop; options keep the desk's own stop check every 10 minutes. Changed 2026-10-07 at Roy's request ("switch the paper desk to shares for SNDK and a separate section for SPY, but another SPY to focus on options so it can learn"). The spread book trades every day SPY has a same-day expiry, whatever the chart says.

option.expiry: about 30 days out, at least 7, that one contract can afford within the options book's budget

hold_to: 30 minutes at most (max_hold_minutes), and never past the 15:40 flatten

pulse_rules.note: Default rule for turning live readings into a Market Pulse bias. Each reading votes bullish (+1), bearish (-1) or not at all; the bias needs min_net_votes net votes, otherwise it is neutral, and neutral never contradicts a setup. Edit the thresholds to match how Roy reads the market.

mxwll._note: Python port of the Mxwll Suite (MPL 2.0, Mxwll Capital) in studies/mxwll.py, read on the desk's candles (5 minutes; extended hours 04:00-20:00 ET by default; both changeable on the settings form). trusted: the desk's own 09:39 boxes are tradable when Ops publishes none that morning. Roy switched this on 2026-10-07 ("let the desk trade its own boxes") without a side-by-side check against his TradingView chart; set it back to false to make them practice-only again.

setup_note: Since 2026-10-07: the setup that came closest to break-even in the backtest (backtests/areas.md on desk-state; touch, red area only, no 2-signal minimum, 0.25% stop, sell after 30 minutes, a ~30-day option). It still lost a little in the backtest; this is paper practice, not a proven edge.
cost_policy: Free sources only: free or free-tier data and services; nothing billed per use or per month without Roy's say-so (README).
